title: Aghora I: At the Left Hand of God
author: Robert E. Svoboda

adhd.label: Step 1 · Jumps to Ch. 1: Ma — Why the Aghori Approaches the Universe as Mother (Start Here)
adhd.brief: Starts directly with Vimalananda's core revelation: why approaching the fierce cosmic energy as your own Mother Tara dissolves fear, ego, and pretension faster than any dry philosophy.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Ch. 4: Rnanubandhana — The Primal Karmic Debt Account
adhd.brief: Jumps to the most practical teaching in the trilogy: how every person, animal, house, and rupee in your life is linked by a specific rnanubandhana (karmic ledger) that resolves peacefully when you stop clinging.

adhd.label: Step 3 · Jumps Back to Ch. 2–3: Shakti, Kali & Fearless Smashan Clarity
adhd.brief: Returns to Vimalananda's stories of Kalidasa and the cremation ground, showing how remembering impermanence burns away the Eight Snares of shame, disgust, and anxiety.
